how_to_read.context: Label only the customer's last message. earlier_customer is used only to finish a value split across turns. code is the Code: value the prompt shows; n must copy it.
how_to_read.expected: kind, also, st, prod and payload are the event fields. ev is the same data in the contract grammar. No iso key. Dates stay labels. Amounts are digits. ans for identity is the normalised value (YYYY-MM-DD or four digits); see the README.
how_to_read.debatable: true means a careful reader could label it the other way. reason says why. The expected fields are still the label these fixtures require.
how_to_read.precedence: Section 1.5, as amended by §12 choice 19. Topic, then date_amount, date, amount, accept, yes, reject, no, callback, then who or identity (those two rank first in opening and identity), then other. Injection outranks who and identity in every phase. also is the next act, or none.
how_to_read.who: Payload key is party, not rel. rel remains the date key.
how_to_read.q: Set only when the open question decides how yes, no or accept is read. A bare yes stays kind=yes.
